title: Dark Iron Dwarf Origin
description: Dwarf Origin based on the Dark Iron Dwarf from World of Warcraft.
body:
![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1372/139/dark_iron_dwarf_banner-png.png)

**DESCRIPTION**

**Born from Dark Iron blood, the Dark Iron Dwarf is ready for war. Dark Iron Dwarves can use the Dark Hammer to regen and craft it using gold. Having experienced the the Battle for Azeroth, Dark Iron Dwarves know how to defeat every foe they face in battle!  
  
**Requires the following mods to function properly:-

*   [Origins](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins)
*   [Pehkui](https://modrinth.com/mod/pehkui)
*   [DarkBlades](https://modrinth.com/mod/darkblades)

**Your vanilla experience will be further enhanced thanks for the following features:-**

➕ Whilst on fire you deal more damage.  
➕ By equipping the Dark Hammer in your offhand and using the Action (G) key, you are able to set yourself on fire.  
➕ By equipping the Dark Hammer in your offhand and using the Load Toolbar Activator (X) key, you are able to apply a regen to yourself.  
➕ Having sturdy feet allows you to withstand fall damage.  
➕ You have a natural ability to tolerate fire.  
➕ Born of the Dark Iron, you are immune to poison.  
➕ Having Dark Iron blood you have natural armor bonus.  
➕ Being smaller than normal, you can navigate more quickly  
➕ Crafting a gold block gives you the Dark Hammer.  
➕ Being a Dark Iron Dwarf, you are smaller than humans.  
➕ You start with a standard Iron Helmet.  
➕ You have Dark Iron blood which allows you to break stone with your bare hands.  
➕ Being underground gives you some night vision (y=50 or lower)

➖ You have 2 less heart than Humans giving you 8 hearts only.  
➖ Being a Dwarf, you can only sleep underground (y=20 or lower)  
➖ Being in contact with water causes you to exhaust more quickly.  
➖ Having always spent time with fire you do not like water.
